description: This file contains SCSS mixins for styling form controls, including focus states and validation states, for a Bootstrap-based theme.

methods.name: form-control-focus
methods.description: A mixin that defines the focus state styling for form controls, customizing border color, background, outline, and optional box shadow.

methods.name: form-validation-state
methods.description: A mixin that styles validation feedback and tooltips, changing their appearance based on validation state and applying styles to various form elements.
